newsitem.title: USA: Philip Morris to set up record label - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Philip Morris to set up record label - WSJ.

text.p: Philip Morris is gearing up to enter the music business for the purpose of promoting cigarette sales to women, The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.
The story said the company has prepared for a year to introduce its own recording label, Woman Thing Music, a name based on the company's new Virginia Slims ad slogan, "It's a Woman Thing."
But fans won't be able to buy the label's CDs, featuring undiscovered women recording artists, at record stores, the story said.
The disks will be available free with purchases of two packs of Virginia Slims in a special package available at supermarkets and other outlets, the story said.
